stemMd: Solve x² = 4x over the real numbers.
explanationMd: Move all terms to one side and factor: x² − 4x = x(x − 4) = 0. Either factor can be zero, giving x = 0 or 4. Avoid dividing by an expression that may be zero.

distractorRationale.d: Dividing by x would lose the zero solution.
distractorRationale.c: The nonzero factor also gives a root.
distractorRationale.b: This treats the equation as x² = 16.
distractorRationale.a: Both zero and four satisfy the original equation.
